answer: No key votes on borrowed sand. Each identity keeps one dune on the atlas, the roll's weight map; a dune grows one grain per epoch, each grain minted by an 8 POA burn its key pays solo. The roll whispers a fresh nonce at each dune; its owner must echo it back signed within 60 seconds. Lottery mapmakers replay one dune's whisper in five per epoch. A missed, stale, or shared whisper burns the whole dune: every grain forfeit, key benched two epochs. N fakes × 8 POA = 8N POA burned; older fakes forfeit more. Honest keys burn the same 8.
